version.description: Schema metadata version per ADR-0016. Project invariant: all rdd-workflow schemas keep version.const='v1' (schema system version, NOT contract version). Contract version lives in properties.version.enum and may be [1, 2] for backward compat.

title: Arch Handoff (ADR-0016 + ADR-0042, contract v2 additive)
description: Schema for .rddf/state/.arch-handoff.json emitted by rdd-arch Phase 6 arch-done. Consumed by guide-plan, propose, roadmap, gate.py, detectors.py, actions.py, scan-state.sh. Per ADR-0042 (Stage 3): contract v2 = base + v2_additive(roadmap_fragments_dir + adr_regex) + v2_additive_routing(planner_feedback lives in independent file .rddf/state/.planner-feedback.json owned by rdd-planner, NOT embedded here to preserve ADR-0028 role boundary).

arch_complete_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when arch-done was completed

adr_count.description: Number of ADR documents discovered (ADR-0000-template excluded)

roadmap_exists.description: Whether roadmap.md was present at arch-done

plan_started_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when plan phase started (null until plan runs)

adr_dir.description: Relative path to ADR directory (e.g. 'docs/adr', 'doc/adr'). Must not be absolute or contain '..'.

roadmap_fragments_dir.description: Directory containing roadmap fragments (phases/, features/, archive/). Added in ADR-0016 v2 (additive).

architecture_dir.description: Relative path to architecture documents directory (e.g. 'docs/architecture')

adr_pattern.description: Glob pattern for ADR files within adr_dir (e.g. 'ADR-*.md', 'DEC-*.md', 'RFD-*.md'). Must be a filename pattern — no path separators or '..' (Momus HIGH#7 — defends against path-traversal even though this is a glob).

discovered.description: Discovery process metadata per artifact type

version.description: Contract version. v1 adds adr_dir/roadmap_path/architecture_dir/adr_pattern/discovered fields (ADR-0016). v2 adds optional roadmap_fragments_dir (additive) + optional adr_regex field for Python regex passthrough (complete-project-yaml-config-gaps M4 Task 4.5). v1 payloads remain valid under v2 schema (backward compat).

adr_regex.description: Optional Python regex pattern for ADR filenames (per project.yaml adr.pattern). Distinct from adr_pattern (glob). Used by populate_lib to pass Python regex through arch-handoff (complete-project-yaml-config-gaps M4 Task 4.5+4.6).
